title: Cut a GitHub release from main with GITHUB_TOKEN
description: Semantic-release on main failed because the platform-ci reusable workflow requires anthusbot_gh_token. Ship an in-repo release job that uses GITHUB_TOKEN, then promote to main so a tag is cut.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Semantic-release succeeded on main: GitHub release v0.1.0 (first tag of the version already in pyproject.toml). The in-repo workflow uses GITHUB_TOKEN. PyPI was skipped because PYPI_TOKEN is unset.
